This drug cross tolerates with Vikz [Vicks? -Ed.]. It is a wonderful experience if I dont freak myself out MUCH like LSD etc. AND DONT DO IT NEAR TO EVERY DAY!!! Its very addicting. I will feel like I'm on X, I will feel like I'm on O 'With these 2 coming 1st', & so on it will switch thro more and more effects based on how low my 'MXE Tolerance' is and how big my dosage is with 40mg being a max dosage with a very low tolerance.
[Reported Dose: 30-40 mg]
